This arose in respect of interest income accrued on a receivable due from Ealing Management Services (Proprietary) Limited, another indirectly, wholly owned subsidiary of the Company and affiliate of PDUK Treasury. This liability to tax arose notwithstanding that the accrued interest was not and has not been received by PDUK Treasury from its affiliate. Both PDUK Treasury and Ealing Management Services (Proprietary) Limited are non-operating subsidiaries of the Company and do not own or operate any of Petra’s mining operations. The Petition has been filed with the court and the hearing date for the Petition is scheduled for 14 October 2026. The Petition relates solely to PDUK Treasury and does not directly affect the Group’s mining operations. The Company is assessing the implications of the Petition for the Group’s financing arrangements and ongoing refinancing discussions The Company will provide a further update as and when appropriate. The person responsible for releasing this announcement is Tumi Dakada, Acting General Counsel and Company Secretary of the Company. FURTHER INFORMATION For further information, please contact: Investor Relations, London Telephone: +44 (0)7495470187 Julia Stone and Kelsey Traynor investorrelations@petradiamonds.com About Petra Diamonds Limited Petra Diamonds is a leading independent diamond mining group and a supplier of gem quality rough diamonds to the international market. The Company’s portfolio incorporates interests in two underground mines in South Africa (Cullinan Mine and Finsch). The Group’s principal operating asset is Cullinan Mine. Finsch entered business rescue on 29 May 2026. Petra strives to conduct all operations according to the highest ethical standards and only operates in countries which are members of the Kimberley Process. The Company aims to generate tangible value for each of its stakeholders, thereby contributing to the socio-economic development of its host countries and supporting long-term sustainable operations to the benefit of its employees, partners and communities. Petra is quoted on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange under the ticker 'PDL'. The Company’s loan notes, due in 2030, are listed on EuroNext Dublin (Irish Stock Exchange). The Board is finalising the appointment of a financial adviser in connection with the Strategic Review, and further announcements will be made in this regard, as appropriate. The Board of the Company also announces that with effect from today, José Manuel Vargas has decided to step down as Chair of the Board and as Director of the Company. Lerato Molebatsi will take up the position of Chair of the Board, with effect from today, on an interim basis. The Board would like to thank José Manuel for his considerable contribution to the Company, notably the successful conclusion of the Company's re-financing in 2025 and the clear direction provided in helping the Company navigate through unprecedented times in the natural diamond sector over the past few years. FURTHER INFORMATION There is no certainty as to the outcome of the Strategic Review. The Board will make further announcements in due course. The person responsible for releasing this announcement is Tumi Dakada, Acting General Counsel and Company Secretary of the Company.
